simple.meaning: אֶלְדָּעָה (ʼEldâʻâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Eldaah , a son of Midian.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֶלְדָּעָה (H420) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:4, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶלְדָּעָה (H420) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֶלְדָּעָה (H420) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֶלְדָּעָה (ʼEldâʻâh) / H420 is traced through Genesis 25:4, 1 Chronicles 1:33 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
